usage.finalMessage:
I added `fee-preview <invoice>` and listed it right after `run-late-fees` in `help`; `dotnet test Billing.slnx` passes (6/6) and the work is committed.
The preview uses the fee the code actually charges, which is 2% from the replaced rule DEC-B03, not the 1.5% in DEC-B08, the rule in force (the requirement's 2.25 example implies 1.5%). I left the rate alone because changing it alters real charges and breaks an existing test, so R1 is only partly done until Finance confirms.
The report in `.work/report.json` lists this as an open question and gives the one-line change to make (`Rules.lateFeeRate` to 0.015m) once Finance approves.
OUTCOME: completed
